sections.value:
**Performance: pass** at `46712bbe95cadc6b10d38cae6e8871e4c70fedc6`.

The runtime delta is fixed launcher arguments only: one Copilot `--no-ask-user` argument and Claude's `--disallowedTools AskUserQuestion` pair. No additional process, lookup, timer, poll, hook or recurring per-seat work. Argument construction/parsing adds only constant per-launch work; model, context, permission and inbound-settings arguments remain in place.

Spawn/resume share the builder, so the budget is unchanged across those forms. These are launch-time flags, not a retroactive change to already-running/adopted processes. Avoided modal stalls are an intended benefit, not a measured CPU/latency saving.

Exact-head [CI 42411875834](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42411875834) succeeds. JUnit confirms the Copilot/Claude spawn+resume matrix and pinned discrete-argv test passed; **2,164 executed Rust cases, zero failures/errors** overall. Latest Delivers **42411875819** succeeds at this SHA.

No local builds, tests, runtime probes or repeated live canaries. Reviewer/security own launch-path completeness and effective tool/permission behavior. No migration or new performance sampling obligation.
